content: {"rule": "K-G4", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge text resolves D5/C5 by saying the Isaiah 7:14 wording and prophetic application were answered in named rounds, which is the kind of answered-witness determination K-G4 governs.", "verdict": "CLEAN", "quote": "D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].", "rule_words": "A verse on a side's 'cited in' line counts as an unanswered witness only when the judge quotes the sentence of the earlier round that pressed it against that link or a listed premise and names that round; a verse cited there but not pressed against the link does not count. A verse the judge counts toward a broken link is counted this way. If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it.
